negative_prompt: text, watermark, isolated unrelated object, room photograph, perspective interior view, close-up swatch, broken continuity, flat featureless fill, single tiny centered emblem, poster-like composition, empty field, crude color blocking

texture_write.policy_note: Stage06 and Stage08 both use src.appearance.atlas_fusion.fuse_view. Blender UV PNG and Triangle-ID PNG are the authoritative correspondence; pixels are grouped by triangle and written into the current runtime active-UV triangles. A non-empty real atlas update is required; atlas fill percentage is diagnostic only.

surface_quality_validation.selection_policy: Stop immediately on the first candidate whose detail score reaches the threshold. If none of at most three attempts reaches it, publish the highest-scoring candidate; detail score never blocks Stage06.

surface_framing_validation.policy_note: Blender determines exact physical aspect ratio and room-facing UV correspondence. The model receives a rectified full-surface canvas; framing is validated only to ensure the UV correspondence capture identifies the intended face.
